@pageContent: accessible name of a page's text area, for screen readers

blockType.@paragraph: a kind of block: a plain paragraph of text. Shown in the / menu (the menu that inserts blocks) and the “Turn into” menu
blockType.@h1: a kind of block: the biggest heading (in the / menu and the “Turn into” menu)
blockType.@h2: a kind of block: a medium heading (in the / menu and the “Turn into” menu)
blockType.@h3: a kind of block: the smallest heading (in the / menu and the “Turn into” menu)
blockType.@bulletList: a kind of block: a list with a bullet before each item (in the / menu and the “Turn into” menu)
blockType.@orderedList: a kind of block: a list with 1, 2, 3 before the items (in the / menu and the “Turn into” menu)
blockType.@taskList: a kind of block: a list of tasks, each with a checkbox
blockType.@blockquote: a kind of block: a quotation set off from the text (a noun, not a verb)
blockType.@codeBlock: a kind of block: a block of program code (a noun)
blockType.@callout: a kind of block: a tinted box with an icon that makes a note stand out (a noun)

group.@basic: heading of a section of the / menu (the menu that inserts blocks): ordinary blocks of text, lists, headings
group.@media: heading of a section of the / menu: pictures and files
group.@planner: heading of a section of the / menu: assignments and events from the school planner
group.@pages: heading of a section of the / menu: sub-pages, databases and links to pages
group.@study: heading of a section of the / menu: flashcards to study (a noun)
group.@inline: heading of a section of the / menu: things inserted within a line of text (today's date)

slash.@empty: shown in the / menu when nothing matches what was typed after the /

text.@keywords: words that also find “Text” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown; the English ones keep working too)

h1.@glyph: short label drawn in the / menu's icon box for Heading 1 (H for heading)
h1.@keywords: words that also find “Heading 1” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep h1

h2.@glyph: short label drawn in the / menu's icon box for Heading 2 (H for heading)
h2.@keywords: words that also find “Heading 2” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep h2

h3.@glyph: short label drawn in the / menu's icon box for Heading 3 (H for heading)
h3.@keywords: words that also find “Heading 3” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep h3

todo.@keywords: words that also find “To-do List” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

bullet.@keywords: words that also find “Bulleted List” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep ul (the HTML name)

numbered.@keywords: words that also find “Numbered List” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep ol (the HTML name)

toggle.title: Toggle
toggle.@title: a kind of block in the / menu: a line that opens and closes to show or hide what's under it (a noun)
toggle.@keywords: words that also find “Toggle” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

quote.@keywords: words that also find “Quote” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

callout.@keywords: words that also find “Callout” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

divider.title: Divider
divider.@title: a kind of block in the / menu: a horizontal line between sections (a noun)
divider.@keywords: words that also find “Divider” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep hr (the HTML name)

code.@keywords: words that also find “Code” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep pre (the HTML name)

math.title: Math Equation
math.description: A formula on its own line, in LaTeX
math.keywords: equation latex tex formula katex block display physics chemistry
math.@keywords: words that also find “Math Equation” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep latex, tex and katex (names)

inlineMath.title: Inline Math
inlineMath.keywords: equation latex tex formula katex inline
inlineMath.@keywords: words that also find “Inline Math” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep latex, tex and katex (names)

table.title: Table
table.@title: a kind of block in the / menu: a simple table of rows and columns (a noun)
table.@keywords: words that also find “Table” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

image.title: Image
image.@title: a kind of block in the / menu: a picture from the computer (a noun)
image.@keywords: words that also find “Image” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep png and jpg (file types)

file.title: File
file.@title: a kind of block in the / menu: a file attached from the file library (a noun)
file.description: Attach a file from your library
file.@keywords: words that also find “File” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep pdf (a file type)

assignment.title: Assignment
assignment.@title: an entry in the / menu that adds a school assignment (homework) and links it in the page (a noun)
assignment.description: Add one and link it here
assignment.keywords: homework task due deadline todo course
assignment.@keywords: words that also find “Assignment” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

event.title: Event
event.@title: an entry in the / menu that adds a calendar event and links it in the page (a noun)
event.description: Add to your calendar and link it here
event.keywords: meeting lecture class exam schedule calendar
event.@keywords: words that also find “Event” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

page.title: Page
page.@title: an entry in the / menu that makes a new page inside this one (a noun)
page.description: Embed a sub-page inside this page
page.@keywords: words that also find “Page” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

database.title: Database
database.@title: an entry in the / menu that makes a new database (a table, board or tracker) inside the page (a noun)
database.description: A table, board or tracker right here
database.keywords: table board kanban tracker list gallery spreadsheet template notion inline
database.@keywords: words that also find “Database” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep kanban and notion (names)

linkedDatabase.title: Linked Database
linkedDatabase.description: Show a database you already have
linkedDatabase.keywords: existing embed view linked table board
linkedDatabase.@keywords: words that also find “Linked Database” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)
linkedDatabase.@menuHeader: heading of the menu that lists the databases to show in the page, after choosing “Linked Database”
linkedDatabase.@none: the only entry of that menu when there are no databases yet; choosing it starts a new one

link.title: Link
link.@title: an entry in the / menu that links to a page, assignment or file (a noun; it types @, which opens the list of them)
link.description: Mention a page, assignment or file
link.@keywords: words that also find “Link” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

flashcard.title: Flashcard
flashcard.@title: a kind of block in the / menu: a card with a term on the front and its answer on the back, to study (a noun)
flashcard.description: A term and its answer, to study later
flashcard.keywords: card study term definition question answer quiz memorize anki vocabulary
flashcard.@keywords: words that also find “Flashcard” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown). Keep anki (a name)

date.title: Today’s Date
date.@title: an entry in the / menu that types today's date into the page (its description is the date itself)
date.@keywords: words that also find “Today’s Date” in the / menu, separated by spaces (never shown)

blockMenu.@turnInto: heading of the part of a block's menu that changes the block into another kind (heading, list, quote…)
blockMenu.@moveUp: block menu command: moves the block above the one before it
blockMenu.@moveDown: block menu command: moves the block below the one after it

blockHandle.@add: tooltip of the + button beside a block
blockHandle.@drag: tooltip of the grip (⋮⋮) beside a block: dragging it moves the block
blockHandle.@options: second, dimmed part of the same tooltip, after “Drag to move”: clicking the grip opens the block's menu

bubble.@bold: tooltip of the button that makes the selected text bold
bubble.@italic: tooltip of the button that makes the selected text italic
bubble.@underline: tooltip of the button that underlines the selected text
bubble.@strikethrough: tooltip of the button that strikes a line through the selected text
bubble.@inlineCode: tooltip of the button that marks the selected text as code (in a monospace font)
bubble.@math: tooltip of the button that turns the selected text into a math formula
bubble.@highlight: tooltip of the button that highlights the selected text (a background tint, like a highlighter pen)
bubble.@color: tooltip and name of the button that opens the text and highlight colors
bubble.@link: label and tooltip of the button that adds a link (a web address) to the selected text
bubble.@sample: the sample letter drawn in each color swatch, in that color, to show what text in it looks like: one letter of your script

textColor.@group: accessible name of the row of colors for the selected text's letters
textColor.@row: small label at the start of that row: the colors for the text itself
textColor.@defaultTip: tooltip of the first swatch in that row: the text's usual color
textColor.@default: accessible name of the first swatch in that row: removes the text's color
textColor.@red: accessible name of the swatch that makes the selected text red; the others in this group are the same for their colors

highlightColor.@group: accessible name of the row of highlight colors (the tint behind the selected text)
highlightColor.@row: small label at the start of that row: the colors of the highlight behind the text (a noun)
highlightColor.@noneTip: tooltip of the first swatch in that row: no highlight
highlightColor.@none: accessible name of the first swatch in that row: removes the highlight
highlightColor.@red: accessible name of the swatch that gives the selected text a red highlight (a red tint behind it); the others in this group are the same for their colors

linkForm.@apply: tooltip of the button that sets the link typed in the field (pressing Enter does the same)

table.@toggleHeader: tooltip: turns the table's first row into a header row, or back

placeholder.paragraph: Write something, or type / for commands
placeholder.@paragraph: grey hint in an empty line of a page; keep the / (typing it opens the menu of blocks)
placeholder.heading: Heading {level}
placeholder.@heading: grey hint in an empty heading; {level} is 1, 2 or 3 (1 the biggest)
placeholder.@toggle: grey hint in the empty first line of a toggle block (the line that opens and closes it)
placeholder.@flashcardFront: grey hint on the empty front of a flashcard
placeholder.@flashcardBack: grey hint on the empty back of a flashcard
placeholder.@listItem: grey hint in an empty item of a bulleted or numbered list (a noun); keep it short

remoteImage.label: Picture from {host}
remoteImage.@label: in a page shared with a friend, stands in for a picture from the web until Show is clicked; {host} is the website, e.g. example.com

lecture.label: Lecture notes
lecture.@label: button on an empty page that fills it with a template for notes taken in a lecture
lecture.hint: Key ideas, questions and a summary
lecture.title: Lecture notes · {date}
lecture.@title: written into the new page as its title; {date} is today's date, e.g. Oct 14
lecture.@keyIdeas: a heading written into the new page
lecture.@questions: a heading written into the new page
lecture.@summary: a heading written into the new page
lecture.@followUp: a heading written into the new page, above a to-do
lecture.review: Review these notes before the next class
lecture.@review: a to-do written into the new page (it also shows on Home)

study.label: Study guide
study.@label: button on an empty page that fills it with a template for studying for a test
study.hint: Topics to cover, key terms as flashcards, practice questions
study.title: Study guide
study.@title: written into the new page as its title
study.@topics: a heading written into the new page, above a checklist of topics to cover
study.@keyTerms: a heading written into the new page, above flashcards
study.cardsIntro: Each card is a term on the front and its meaning on the back. Study them from Flashcards.
study.@cardsIntro: a paragraph written into the new page; “Flashcards” is the name of the Flashcards view in the sidebar: use the same word
study.@practice: a heading written into the new page

formulas.label: Formula sheet
formulas.@label: button on an empty page that fills it with a template for math or science formulas
formulas.hint: Equations to know, what each symbol means, and a worked example
formulas.title: Formula sheet
formulas.@title: written into the new page as its title
formulas.@keyFormulas: a heading written into the new page
formulas.@where: written into the new page under an empty formula: the start of a sentence explaining its symbols (“where v is the speed”), for the person to finish
formulas.@workedExample: a heading written into the new page: an example problem solved step by step
formulas.@remember: a heading written into the new page, above a flashcard (things to remember)

cards.label: Flashcards
cards.@label: button on an empty page that starts a deck of flashcards in it
cards.hint: Type a question, Enter for the answer, Enter again for the next card
cards.@hint: tooltip of that button; Enter is the key
cards.title: Flashcards
cards.@title: written into the new page (a deck of flashcards) as its title

checklist.label: Checklist
checklist.@label: button on an empty page that starts a to-do list in it
checklist.hint: A list of things to do (they show on Home too)
checklist.@hint: tooltip of that button; Home is the start screen of the app: use the name it has in the sidebar
checklist.title: To do
checklist.@title: written into the new page (a to-do list) as its title

@taskCheckbox: accessible name of a to-do's checkbox in a page, read by screen readers; {text} is the to-do's text
taskCheckboxEmpty: Task item checkbox for empty task item
@taskCheckboxEmpty: accessible name of the checkbox of a to-do that has no text yet, read by screen readers
